verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents bank feed connections with automatic transaction import, categorization, and reconciliation ('flowing into Zoho Books automatically'), plus a dedicated Bank Transactions/Bank Rules API for automated categorization and reconciliation, online payments integration, and 500+ integrations including payroll-adjacent tools. Missing for 10: explicit named payroll-system integrations (e.g., Gusto/ADP) with setup documentation and independent/hands-on verification that bank feeds work reliably in practice.
